title: Python Basics: Syntax, Variables & Operators
description: Mixed-format quiz (MCQ, true/false, select-all) on print/input, comments, variables, naming rules, datatypes, and all operator categories — straight from the course notebook.

questions.question: What does print("Hello", "Alice") output?
Which symbol starts a comment in Python?
What is the file extension for a Python script?
By default, what datatype does input() always return?
Which built-in function returns the datatype of a value, e.g. ___(var1)?
Which function explicitly converts a string into an integer, as in age = ___(input("Enter age: "))?
Which numeric datatype is written with a decimal point, e.g. 3.14?
What does the ** operator do?
What is the result of 5 // 2?
Which operator category do ==, !=, >, and < belong to?
Which operator checks whether a value exists inside a sequence, e.g. 3 in [1, 2, 3]?
In the expression 2 + 3 * 2 ** 2, which operator is evaluated first?
options: They evaluate left to right regardless
